messages.author: b8c77fa5305c80cb
messages.subject: correctly manipulating data.frames
parts:
lets say I have a data frame d as created in data.frame example:
L3 <- LETTERS[1:3]
(d <- data.frame(cbind(x = 1, y = 1:10), fac = sample(L3, 10, replace = TRUE)))


printing d I get:


   x  y fac
1  1  1   B
2  1  2   C
3  1  3   B
4  1  4   B
5  1  5   C
6  1  6   A
7  1  7   A
8  1  8   B
9  1  9   A
10 1 10   A


Now, if I want for example to set x for all rows with y<3 to be 3, I would do:

d[d$y<3,]$x=3

so now I got:
   x  y fac
1  3  1   B
2  3  2   C
3  1  3   A
4  1  4   B
5  1  5   C
6  1  6   B
7  1  7   C
8  1  8   A
9  1  9   B
10 1 10   A


Now I want to set all cases where y>20 to 20 so I would do:

d[d$y>20,]$x=20

This however fails with the message:

Error in `$<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, "x", value = 20) : 
  replacement has 1 row, data has 0
because d[d$y>20,] has 0 rows and thus no names.
Is there a way to do this safely (other than do an if which would mean do the calculation twice?)
